player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Umdlali wazama ukwamkela intengiselwano ngaphandle kokuba nezixhobo eziyimfuneko.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Ngempelo engahambeli. Koloni {col} ikaphaya kwenza.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Umdlali {player_id} uzame ukwenza isindululo sokurhweba engenazo izixhobo eziyimfuneko.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Umdlali {player_id} wenze isindululo sokurhweba ngendlela engalunganga.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Umdlali {player_id} akazange enze isindululo esitsha sokurhweba.

offers.proposal: Player {player_id} enze impelo kuPlayer {opponent_id}: Izinto eziphakelwa: {offered} -> Izinto ezikufunwa: {requested}

outcome.win: Umdlali {winner_id} uphumelele ngokuba nenzuzo enkulu kwixabiso lempahla.
outcome.draw: Utshintsho olufanayo kwixabiso lempahla kubo bonke abadlali.
